ios.desc:
Running out of space? iBoostUp finds the clutter in your photo library and contacts, and helps you clear it in just a few taps. It all happens directly on your device: your photos and contacts are never uploaded.

From the makers of iBoostUp for Mac, keeping Apple devices tidy since 2010.

ALL YOUR CLUTTER IN ONE PLACE
• Duplicate photos are grouped so you keep the best one and clear the rest
• Similar shots and bursts of photos, with the sharpest one automatically picked for you
• Blurry photos and your old screenshots
• Large videos, all sorted by size
• Easily see how much space you can free before you delete anything

SWIPE THROUGH YOUR CAMERA ROLL
Swipe left to delete, or right to keep. A super quick, satisfying way to review your photos month by month. Easily undo if you change your mind.

SHRINK VIDEOS BUT KEEP THE MOMENT
Compress big videos at the quality you choose, and see exactly how much space you save. Turn Live Photos into still photos to save even more space!

TIDY DUPLICATE CONTACTS
Find contacts saved twice and merge them in one tap, and clear out incomplete ones with no name or number. iBoostUp backs up your contacts first so nothing is ever lost.

IS YOUR DEVICE SECURE?
A simple iBoostUp Score checks your passcode, Face ID or Touch ID and iOS updates. We'll give you clear steps to fix anything that's missing.

HANDY EXTRAS
• Home Screen widgets showing free space and your iBoostUp Score
• An optional weekly reminder to clean up. We show no other alerts
• Works on both your iPhone and iPad, available in 12 languages

SAFE BY DESIGN
Deleted photos go to Recently Deleted, where you can easily get them back for 30 days. Nothing is ever removed without your say-so.

FREE AND PREMIUM
iBoostUp is free to download: scan everything, delete screenshots, review a batch of photos a day by swiping, and check your security. iBoostUp Premium adds cleaning of duplicate, similar and blurry photos, video compression, Live Photo conversion, contact merging and unlimited swiping.

Premium is available yearly, monthly or as a one-time purchase. No weekly plans. The yearly plan may include a free trial for new subscribers, and we remind you the day before it ends.

Subscriptions are charged to your Apple Account and renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel them anytime in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.

Privacy Policy https://iboostup.
